blocks.zh: 本页译自 EVE University Wiki：Incursion fitting principles
本文介绍的信息代表我们在EVE University入侵社区的做法。这不代表运行入侵的最佳或唯一方式。我们在效率方面做出一些妥协以换取额外安全，创造一个任何人都能站出来学习新角色的环境。
入侵舰队依赖良好的抗性、足够的缓冲、指挥脉冲和主动后勤。敌人实在太多，无法装配足够强的本地抗性，更不用说牺牲一小部分舰队带后勤而不是更多输出船，让其余输出船能装更多攻击模块，舰队整体表现会更好。
一旦你有足够好的抗性，剩余空余槽位应该用来增强你（和舰队）的伤害潜力。抗性不足显然危险，但抗性过度不仅浪费，还可能以牺牲攻击能力为代价带来另一种危险。
请参阅入侵准备了解我们要求EVE University入侵社区成员训练的技能。虽然其他社区可能有类似要求，但这只是我们的建议。

zh: 装甲抗性：EVE University入侵社区使用装甲抗性教义来运行遗址。我们目标是所有输出舰船在每种伤害类型上都有67%装甲抗性，并在任何指挥脉冲应用前拥有约10,000装甲生命值。
改装件：我们建议的配装设计与公共装甲总部社区的建议配装兼容的改装件。这允许我们的成员参与大学无法提供的内容，而不必购买单独的舰船或花费过多ISK重新改装。这些公共总部集团的配装可以在这里、这里和这里找到。
功能模块：一般来说，我们偏好功能中槽主要装索敌计算机和感应增强器的组合。除此之外，目标标记涂装器也很有用，还有停滞缠绕光束。

DronesDrones will not be called upon in every fleet, as they are of marginal benefit. However, they can get fleets out of sticky situations on occasion, so we ask that every ship be fitted with at least a set ofAcolytesand a set ofArmor Maintenance Botsfor use in emergencies.

TurretsWe do not accept ships that use missiles as their primary weapon system. This is due to the flight time of missiles leading to DPS being wasted on missiles which are in flight to targets which have already been killed.

Damage ControlAll of our fits make use of aDamage Control, as this both provides an okay bump in armor resistance, but vitally provides significant hull resistance, which could be the difference between a ship living or dying in an emergency.

Hyperspatial RigA significant amount of time in fleet is spent in warp between sites. We include this rig as it is compatible with headquarters fits on ships where that applies, and by having it on all of our ships it allows the entire fleet to warp faster, thus making the fleet more efficient.

blocks.zh: 购买新船时很容易忽视改装件选择的重要性。虽然新手拿到wiki上的基础配装时通常不需要担心这个问题，但对于要换新船的人来说——这极其重要，因为它严重影响你在灵活性和功能槽位方面的选择（这在入侵中就是一切）。不要在临时配装上花太多ISK——要么在攒理想配装时用便宜的"够用"配装，要么等到有足够资金一步到位。

zh: Defense RigsIt is common for fits to have one or a combination of an Explosive, Thermal, or Kinetic armor resistance rig. It is also common for some fits to utilize a trimark armor pump rig, especially for those ships with less raw armor HP such as the Praxis. This can help eek out enough armor HP to avoid the need for a plate in the lowslots.

Offence RigsGoing for damage means that you're limited somewhat due to the high calibration cost of rigs such as Burst Aerators. However, these rigs are often utilized in headquarters fits, particularly in the Vindicator and Marauders.

Hyperspatial RigsAlternatively, Hyperspatial Velocity Optimization rigs offer the benefit of allowing your ship to warp faster, which is particularly advantageous in a situation where every fleet member is capable of the same, minimising the time the fleet spends in warp thus improving fleet efficiency. All of the EVE University Incursion Community doctrine ships have a Tech 2 hyperspatial rig, so we would suggest including one if you can.

blocks.zh: 总体而言，我们建议将舰船改装得与公共总部社区兼容。这样同一个船体既可用于那些社区的舰队，也可用于EVE大学入侵社区。我们希望通过这种灵活性降低准入门槛，鼓励大家探索更多内容。
